blocks.text: MANIKA, Philippines–Some of the finest talents in the Ladies Philippine Golf Tour swing into action on Wednesday when they lock horns with some of the region’s best in the Kenda Tires TLPGA Open. Carrying a total purse of NT$4 million, the 54-hole event marks another significant step in the LPGT’s growing presence on the international circuit, this being a co-sanctioned tournament with TLPGA, with 20 LPGT players set to challenge the hosts and other foreign contenders at the Taichung International Golf Club. And with the tournament moving to Taichung for the first time after previous TLPGA-LPGT co-sanctioned stops in other Taiwan […]...
